title: Designing the New Look Suit for Men
summary: He designed a men's suit featured in Look and Life, and describes its cut.

blocks.x: Lee, didn't you also design some clothes for men?

Yes, I designed a suit shortly after the Second World War, when the ladies' styles came out with the long skirts and dresses. Well, I figured the men should have something keeping in trend with the women, so I designed a suit called the New Look Suit for Men, which was in Look Magazine and Life Magazine, and was made in New Orleans and in St. Louis.
Lee, didn't, weren't there pictures of it in Look Magazine and some of the radios and other newspapers?
Yes, it was in Look Magazine and was also very frequently discussed on radio at that time about the New Look Suit for Men.
What was the cut of the suit? What did it look like?

Well, it was a very trim suit and had the, I'll say a long coat, not too long, but long enough, and it had a removable belt. The belt went all the way around. You could wear it as a sport coat with the belt, or you could remove the belt and wear it as a dress coat.
